message: 最後の敵、意外な味方
In the midst of a fierce, grueling battle where blinding light scorched the flesh--
At last, an opening appears.

name: Bylous
message: 「Right there!!」
First strike--Bylous swings his iron fist.
Amid a deafening roar and white light, Bylous and I swap places.

name: Azel
message: 「Die! Die!」
In an instant, Bylous darts forward as if flying!
Picturing the trajectory of death hurtling toward me, I thrust out a fist packed with everything I have to deflect its vector.

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaaah!」
The Demon Lord's power and the Guardian Angel's power clad around my fist clash head-on with the power of infinity.
A solid impact. Excruciating pain in my fist.
Even after deflecting it, I'm forced backward. The soles of my feet feel like they're catching fire from the friction.
Bracing myself with all my might, I barely manage to keep from falling.

name: Azel
message: 「I-Impossible!」
Bylous's fist had pierced right through the warped space surrounding Azel and landed squarely on her left flank.
Her petite body is blown backward without a sound.

name: Bylous
message: 「You are no warrior. Just a little girl swinging around infinite power at random. How boring.」
Azel halts abruptly in midair, touches down on the ground, and glares at us.
On the surface, she's completely unharmed.

name: Azel
message: 「Curse you! Damn you, Demon Lord! You ignorant, fearless demons! Would you reject God's mercy?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Stop this already! Why do we have to fight?!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll kill you! Right this instant.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
It won't reach her. My voice won't reach Azel.

name: Bylous
message: 「Proxy. Another crack has formed in your vessel. In that state, even if you manage to destroy us, can you withstand Re-Crea?」
Azel glared at us with eyes burning with fury.
Just like that, her figure faded and vanished.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「She merely warped space and disappeared inside it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just like Re-Crea. God's Proxy, alright.」
Bylous turned to face me.

name: Bylous
message: 「You truly are the Demon Lord. Synn Sakura.」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know my name!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Asking even me for help on the spur of the moment and pulling it off. Only the Demon Lord could do that.」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, you are lacking. Lacking to be the Demon Lord who is both my enemy and my dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「...What am I lacking.」
That was one of the very things I had wanted to ask Melilot-san.

name: Bylous
message: 「Accept it. Completely. That you are the Demon Lord. Something is holding that back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Something?」

name: Bylous
message: 「If I knew, I would tell you. If I could, I would have done so, and in fact, I have taken every measure I possibly could up until now. Yet, I do not know what that something is.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Taken every measure?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Little time remains until Re-Crea. Realize it for yourself before then.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Otherwise, my dream will not be fulfilled, and on December 24 by your world's calendar, the world will collapse. That is all.」

name: Synn
message: 「The world will collapse!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Become the complete Demon Lord before then. I will be looking forward to it.」
Bylous laughed and melted away into the darkness.
I was left behind with Melilot-san, who was still unconscious.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-an ambulance!? B-but even if I take a demon to the hospital. Yet, what if it's too late!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calm down, Synn-sama. There's only one place to contact in a situation like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Kujou family. She and Helena know each other. Plus, she must've consulted her beforehand about tonight's move too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see!」
Just then, a luxury foreign car glided in from the courtyard entrance and came to a stop.
It was the car used to pick up and drop off Lolotte.
Or rather, it was a scene that felt like something I had seen before.

name: Helena
message: 「Where's Melilot!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san! It looks like Melilot-san has just passed out. Still, we should get her properly checked out.」

name: Helena
message: 「She isn't injured, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. Though she's completely drained her magic power. Probably fired off a few heavy-duty spells even before unleashing that last one, too.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see...」

name: Helena
message: 「In that case, all we can do is let her rest quietly and wait for her to recover.」
Riesling-san, who had stepped out right after her, effortlessly lifted Melilot-san's body and carried her into the back seat.

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the emergency treatment to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Helena
message: 「What happened here? Give me the short version.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, ma'am.」
I recounted everything, from finding Melilot-san already collapsed when I arrived, through my battle with Azel, Bylous's sudden appearance, and Azel's retreat.
I glossed over the part about me being the Demon Lord. I felt guilty about it.

name: Helena
message: 「...I see.」

name: Riesling
message: 「It appears to match our observation data as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Observation?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Immediately after receiving Melilot's message, we aimed every single one of the academy's observation instruments directly at this location.」
Then do they know I'm the Demon Lord too!?

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」

name: Helena
message: 「Thank you. For saving my friend's life.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to thank someone, thank Bylous. I--」

name: Helena
message: 「If you hadn't held out as hard as you did, Synn-chan, Melilot would have been killed before he ever showed up.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Always pulling reckless stunts like that.」

name: Riesling
message: 「From what I gather from Synn-sama's account, it seems he appeared specifically to save Synn-sama.」
Because I'm the Demon Lord. Still, why would he need to save the Demon Lord?

name: Helena
message: 「He likely has some ulterior motive. Still, this is the worst-case scenario. To think Azel-chan was an agent of Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san. Just what is Re-Crea in the first place? Isn't it just when demons appear in this world by taking advantage of natural disasters!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Helena. Now that things have come to this, we cannot very well keep it hidden from the members of the Student Council.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll explain everything to everyone on the Student Council tomorrow. For tonight, just go on home.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan. Please see Synn-chan all the way home.」
